research_notes: Blocked for headline calculation: unusually precise tenure evidence exists, but full-time status of each agronomy interval remains unverified.

Targeted full-time search found a primary La Trobe testimonial that supports some full-time employment during MBA study. It cannot safely be extrapolated to the full 2002–2016 agronomy career or allocated between employers without study dates and a CV.
Do not sum CEO tenure into private enterprise under the current association exclusion. Month-level durations retained without imposing an unapproved conversion convention.

2026-10-01: resolved early agronomy employer Wayne Skinner Rural Supplies/Croptec using contemporary2005 consultant table and public professional-profile index; preserved conflicting month boundaries instead of silently replacing official dates. Added pre-degree Ardmona farm work and family-vineyard activity. University confirms MBA2017, narrowing context of FT testimonial without proving a dated FT job interval.

Avenues: official/member/party first-person chronology and maiden speech,2005 horticulture report, Netafim-era industry material, university alumni2020 article and postgraduate testimonial, university campus proposal at https://treasury.gov.au/sites/default/files/2019-03/360985-La-Trobe-University.pdf p7 (night classes but no personal FT interval), Churchill biography and public profile index. Direct LinkedIn returned429, not retried. Full-time statement in campus proposal p6 belongs to Geraldine Christou, not Birrell. Follow-up: personal FT contract/leave and MBA enrolment dates, reconcile January/February2002 and August/September2008 boundaries, identify Ardmona farm and dates, paid status/family-vineyard hours, any work during initial university/travel breaks. No totals manufactured.

Follow-up2October2026: public LinkedIn education index supplies MBA2015–2017 and university source establishes a2020 volunteer leadership-course role. Prior note about missing study-start year is now partly resolved; exact term dates and allocation of full-time testimonial to Netafim versus Committee for Greater Shepparton remain unknown. Searches of Netafim conference/industry records corroborate employer but provide no hours. Victorian GROW hearing full-time statement belongs to Lisa Hulm, not Birrell; March2022 newspaper full-time statement describes his wife, not him. Do not convert these into personal FT evidence. Next seek contemporaneous2015 MBA enrolment/employer arrangement and actual agronomy employment terms; reconcile official/profile month discrepancy. Early farm identity and vineyard pay still unresolved.

Third follow-up3October2026: repeated targeted searches for Netafim, Croptec/Wayne Skinner, MBA and full-time terms returned the same La Trobe testimonial and broad14-year agronomist descriptions, but no employment contract, hours or employer-specific full-time statement. The MBA2015–2017 window crosses the February/March2016 change from Netafim to Committee for Greater Shepparton, so the testimonial cannot be allocated safely to the whole Netafim interval or used to calculate headline years. No reliable evidence resolved the one-month boundary discrepancies, Ardmona legal employer or vineyard pay. No material record or numerical change.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: targeted searches for Netafim full-time status, Wayne Skinner Rural Supplies/Croptec, agronomy contracts and the2016 CEO transition returned known chronology or point-in-time observations only. A Victorian irrigation resource names Birrell at Netafim in April2009 and a council archive names him Committee CEO on6May2016, both within already supported official intervals and neither supplying hours or appointment boundaries. Apparent full-time search hits again referred to other people, not Birrell, and were rejected. The Netafim/Croptec employment fractions, MBA-related leave, month-boundary conflicts, Ardmona legal employer and vineyard pay remain unresolved; no numerical change.
